Class Circle

java.lang.Object
com.cooke.shapes.Shape
com.cooke.shapes.TwoDimensionalShape
com.cooke.shapes.Circle
public class Circle extends TwoDimensionalShape
Circle Class Creates a Circle object with with a radius; The circle's area is calculated when a new circle is created and when the radius is adjusted. filename: Circle.java creation date: 20261027
